title: Neon Plasma Armory
theme: Original neon industrial science fiction with dark gunmetal bodies, compact cyan energy chambers, and restrained violet accents

generation.perspective: strict side view, muzzle pointing right, one direction only
generation.outline: Use a one-pixel dark outline at final sprite resolution and the same outline weight on every weapon
generation.lighting: Cool cyan energy core, upper-left neutral rim light, restrained violet highlights, no cast shadow

assets.name: Plasma Pistol
assets.description: a compact one-handed plasma pistol with a short barrel, readable grip, trigger guard, and cyan energy chamber
prompt_notes: Compact silhouette occupying about sixty percent of the shared canvas width
No stock and no extra accessories

assets.name: Ion Pistol
assets.description: a sturdy one-handed ion pistol with a squared muzzle, readable grip, trigger guard, and small violet capacitor
prompt_notes: Distinct from the plasma pistol through a heavier squared front section
No stock and no extra accessories

assets.name: Plasma Carbine
assets.description: a compact two-handed plasma carbine with a short stock, grip, trigger, cyan energy chamber, and medium barrel
prompt_notes: Keep all functional parts readable at 128 by 64 pixels

assets.name: Pulse Rifle
assets.description: a long two-handed pulse rifle with a slim stock, grip, trigger, segmented energy rail, barrel, and muzzle
prompt_notes: Long clean silhouette with one continuous upper energy rail

assets.name: Energy Shotgun
assets.description: a broad two-handed energy shotgun with a reinforced stock, grip, trigger, twin cyan chambers, thick barrel, and wide muzzle
prompt_notes: Use two integrated energy chambers rather than separate objects

assets.name: Rail Rifle
assets.description: a precision rail rifle with a skeletal stock, grip, trigger, long metallic accelerator rails, and narrow muzzle
prompt_notes: No detached scope and no bipod

assets.name: Arc Launcher
assets.description: a heavy arc launcher with a compact rear stock, grip, trigger, large circular violet capacitor, reinforced body, and short emitter
prompt_notes: Make the circular capacitor part of the weapon body
Heavy but still completely visible inside the shared canvas

assets.name: Ion Cannon
assets.description: a heavy two-handed ion cannon with a braced stock, two grips, trigger, large cyan core, armored body, and wide forward emitter
prompt_notes: Keep the weapon horizontal and fully contained with generous edge padding

notes: Use the approved ORION palette and functional vocabulary without copying an existing weapon design or asset pack.
